name: Lothal
mainText: Start the game with this base in play.

name: Rodia
mainText: When you reveal Rodia, deal 1 damage to the enemy base for each enemy card in the galaxy row. Then discard each of those cards from the galaxy row.

name: Corellia
mainText: When you reveal Corellia, purchase an Empire or neutral card from the galaxy row for free and add it to your hand.

name: Kessel
mainText: When you reveal Kessel, exile up to 3 cards from your hand or discard pile.

name: Kafrene
mainText: When you play a neutral card for the first time each turn, draw 1 card.

name: Mustafar
mainText: When you reveal Mustafar, gain 4 [resource].

name: Ord Mantell
mainText: While Ord Mantell is your base, you can bounty hunt 1 neutral unit in the galaxy row each turn, using its cost as its target value. If you defeat that card, gain [resource] equal to its cost.

name: Coruscant
mainText: When your turn begins, look at the top 2 cards of the galaxy deck. Place one on top of the deck and discard the other.

name: Death Star
mainText: Spend 4 [resource] to destroy a capital ship your opponent has in play or a capital ship in the galaxy row.

name: Endor
mainText: While Endor is your base, each of your Trooper and Vehicle units gains 1 [attack].

name: Gozanti Cruiser
mainText: Discard 1 card from your hand to draw 1 card.
flavorText: The Gozanti-class armored transport is used throughout the Empire to ferry goods and personnel between worlds.

name: Imperial Carrier
mainText: While Imperial Carrier is in play, each of your Fighter units gains 1 [attack].
flavorText: The Imperial carrier can hold up to forty-eight starfighters in its four hangars, making it an effective mobile headquarters.

name: Star Destroyer
flavorText: The distinct profile of the Imperial-class Star Destroyer is a symbol of the Empire's strength. Stationing just one in orbit of a planet could quell local unrest.

name: Imperial Shuttle
flavorText: A versatile craft, the Lambda-class shuttle is used to transport resources, troopers, and even high-ranking dignitaries.

name: Stormtrooper
flavorText: Elite soldiers of the Empire, the white-and-black armor of Imperial stormtroopers inspires fear across the galaxy.

name: Inquisitor
mainText: When you play Inquisitor, choose: They gain 1 [attack], 1 [resource], or 1 [force] this turn.
flavorText: Force wielders in service to the Empire, the Inquisitors are elite Jedi hunters.

name: Y-Wing
mainText: Exile this unit to deal 2 damage to your opponent's base or a capital ship they have in play.

name: U-Wing
mainText: If the Force is with you, repair 3 damage from your base.

name: Han Solo
mainText: Draw 1 card (2 cards instead if you have the Millennium Falcon in play).
flavorText: You know, sometimes I amaze even myself.

name: Cassian Andor
mainText: When Cassian Andor defeats a target in the galaxy row, your opponent discards 1 card from their hand.

name: B-Wing
rewardText: Reward: Exile up to 2 cards from your hand or discard pile.
mainText: Your opponent must choose: Either they discard 1 card from their hand, or this unit gains 2 [attack].

name: Princess Leia
mainText: Purchase a Rebel card from the galaxy row for free. If the Force is with you, place that card on top of your deck.

name: Millennium Falcon
rewardText: Reward: Purchase a card of your faction for free.
mainText: Add a unique ([unique]) unit from your discard pile to your hand.

name: Luke Skywalker
mainText: If the Force is with you, destroy a capital ship your opponent has in play.
flavorText: I am a Jedi, like my father before me.

name: Tie Fighter
mainText: If you have a capital ship in play, draw 1 card.
flavorText: Fighters coming in! – Lando Calrissian

name: Admiral Piett
mainText: While Admiral Piett is in play, each of your capital ships gains 1 [attack].
flavorText: Intensify forward firepower!

name: Tie Bomber
rewardText: Reward: Exile 1 card from your hand or discard pile.
mainText: Discard 1 card from the galaxy row.
flavorText: TIE bombers carry enough firepower to destroy virtually any target.

name: Baze Malbus
mainText: Baze Malbus gains 1 [attack] for each Rebel base in your opponent's victory pile.
flavorText: You don't look happy.

name: Scout Trooper
rewardText: Reward: Exile a card from your hand or discard pile.
mainText: Reveal the top card of the galaxy deck. If it is an Empire card, gain 1 [resource]. If it is an enemy card, discard it.

name: Death Trooper
mainText: While the Force is with you, this unit gains 2 [attack].

name: Tie Interceptor
mainText: Reveal the top card of the galaxy deck. If it is an Empire card, draw 1 card. If it is an enemy card, discard it.

name: Moff Jerjerrod
mainText: Look at the top card of the galaxy deck. If the Force is with you, you may swap that card with a card from the galaxy row.

name: General Veers
mainText: If you have a Trooper or Vehicle in play, draw 1 card.
flavorText: Target, maximum firepower!

name: AT-ST
rewardText: Reward: Exile up to 2 cards from your hand or discard pile.
mainText: Discard 1 card from the galaxy row.
flavorText: Equipped with two chin-mounted blaster cannons, the Imperial AT-ST obliterates targets at range.

name: Landing Craft
mainText: Choose: Gain 4 [resource], or repair 4 damage from your base.

name: Director Krennic
mainText: Draw 1 card (2 cards instead if your base is the Death Star).
flavorText: We stand here amidst my achievement, not yours!

name: Boba Fett
mainText: When Boba Fett defeats a target in the galaxy row, draw 1 card.
flavorText: He's no good to me dead.

name: AT-AT
rewardText: Reward: Purchase a card of your faction for free.
mainText: Add a Trooper from your discard pile to your hand.

name: Snowspeeder
rewardText: Reward: Exile 1 card from your hand or discard pile.
mainText: Your opponent discards 1 card from their hand.
flavorText: “Watch that crossfire, boys!” – Luke Skywalker

name: Grand Moff Tarkin
mainText: Add an Empire card from the galaxy row to your hand. You must exile that card at the end of your turn.

name: Darth Vader
mainText: While the Force is with you, Darth Vader gains 4 [attack].
flavorText: You don't know the power of the dark side.

name: Z-95 Headhunter
mainText: If your opponent has a capital ship in play, draw 1 card.
flavorText: While considered outdated by modern standards, the Z-95 is still deployed by many factions across the galaxy.

name: Jawa Scavenger
mainText: Exile this unit to purchase a card from the galaxy discard pile as if it were in the galaxy row.
flavorText: Utinni!

name: Kel Dor Mystic
mainText: Exile this unit to exile 1 card from your hand or discard pile.
flavorText: Some Force users choose to live in exile to hide their special abilities.

name: Rodian Gunslinger
mainText: This unit gains 2 [attack] while attacking a target in the galaxy row.
flavorText: The promise of fast credits inspires gunslingers from many species to take up bounty hunting.

name: Lobot
mainText: When you play Lobot, choose: He gains 2 [attack], 2 [resource], or 2 [force] this turn.
flavorText: Lobot's cybernetic implant can interface directly with Cloud City's central network, allowing him to respond quickly to any situation.

name: Bossk
mainText: When Bossk defeats a target in the galaxy row, gain 1 [resource].
flavorText: Trandoshans are renowned hunters. For members of Bossk’s species, the hunt is a spiritual rite of passage.

name: Fang Fighter
mainText: When you purchase this unit, add it to your hand (and draw 1 card if the Force is with you).
flavorText: The Mandalorian Fang Fighter is a fast and highly maneuverable starfighter built specifically for dogfighting.

name: Twi'lek Smuggler
mainText: Place the next card you purchase this turn on top of your deck.
flavorText: Every faction in the Outer Rim employs smugglers to help them acquire the goods they need, legal or otherwise.

name: Dengar
mainText: When Dengar defeats a target in the galaxy row, gain 2 [resource].
flavorText: A dangerous and successful bounty hunter, Dengar demands a high price for his services.

name: Quarren Mercenary
mainText: When you purchase this unit, exile 1 card from your hand or discard pile (up to 2 cards instead if the Force is with you).
flavorText: Soldiers in the Outer Rim will work for any faction, so long as the pay is good.

name: HWK-290
mainText: Exile this unit to repair 4 damage from your base.
flavorText: The fast HWK-290 is favored by smugglers who specialize in transporting essential goods to dangerous places.

name: IG-88
mainText: When IG-88 defeats a target in the galaxy row, exile 1 card from your hand or discard pile.
flavorText: Programmed as an independent assassin droid, IG-88 became a feared bounty hunter.

name: Lando Calrissian
mainText: Draw 1 card. If the Force is with you, your opponent discards 1 card from their hand.
flavorText: This deal is getting worse all the time.

name: Jabba's Sail Barge
mainText: Add a Bounty Hunter from your discard pile to your hand.
flavorText: Jabba the Hutt uses his massive sail barge to travel the Dune Sea and host parties.

name: Jabba The Hutt
mainText: Exile 1 card from your hand to draw 1 card (2 cards instead if the Force is with you).
flavorText: I shall enjoy watching you die.

name: Duros Spy
rewardText: Reward: Exile 1 card from your hand or discard pile.
mainText: Your opponent must choose: Either they discard 1 card from their hand, or you gain 1 [resource].

name: Chirrut Imwe
mainText: While the Force is with you, Chirrut Imwe gains 2 [attack].
flavorText: I am one with the Force, and the Force is with me.

name: Rebel Commando
mainText: Your opponent discards 1 card from their hand (at random if the Force is with you).

name: X-Wing
mainText: If the Force is with you, draw 1 card.
flavorText: Lock S-foils in attack position. – Red Leader

name: Chewbacca
mainText: If you have another unique (◆) unit in play, draw 1 card.
flavorText: Rwaarr!

name: Jyn Erso
mainText: Look at your opponent's hand. If the Force is with you, place 1 card from their hand on top of their deck.

name: C-ROC Cruiser
mainText: Discard 1 card from your hand to repair 3 damage from your base.
flavorText: The C-ROC is a modified Gozanti-class cruiser used to transport goods across the Outer Rim.

name: Blockade Runner
mainText: Though designed as a diplomatic courier ship, the Corellian CR90 corvette is often used to run planetary blockades.

name: Nebulon-B Frigate
mainText: Choose: Repair 3 damage from your base, or gain 3 [resource].
flavorText: They're heading for the medical frigate. - Wedge Antilles

name: Outer Rim Pilot
mainText: Exile this unit to gain 1 [force].
flavorText: Most of the best freighter pilots are to be found here. – Obi-Wan Kenobi

name: Dantooine
mainText: Start the game with this base in play.

name: Yavin 4
mainText: When your opponent discards a card from their hand during your turn, deal 2 damage to their base.

name: Mon Cala
mainText: When you reveal Mon Cala, purchase a Rebel or neutral card from the galaxy row for free and add it to your hand.

name: Dagobah
mainText: When you reveal Dagobah, exile up to 3 cards from your hand or discard pile.

name: Bespin
mainText: When you play a neutral card for the first time each turn, draw 1 card.

name: Alderaan
mainText: When you reveal Alderaan, gain 4 [resource].

name: Hoth
mainText: While Hoth is your base, prevent the first 2 damage dealt to Hoth each turn.

name: Jedha
mainText: While Jedha is your base, add the first neutral card you purchase each turn to your hand. You must exile that card at the end of your turn.

name: Tatooine
mainText: When you reveal Tatooine, swap a card in the galaxy row with a Rebel card from the galaxy discard pile and gain 1 [resource].

name: Sullust
mainText: While Sullust is your base, place the first card you purchase each turn on top of your deck.

name: Rebel Transport
mainText: Choose: Repair 2 damage from your base, or gain 1 [resource].
flavorText: The first transport is away!

name: Hammerhead Corvette
mainText: Exile this capital ship to destroy a capital ship your opponent has in play, or an enemy capital ship in the galaxy row.
flavorText: Prepare for impact! –Kado Oquoné

name: Mon Calamari Cruiser
flavorText: The Mon Calamari cruiser packs an enormous punch and is capable of going head-to-head with an Imperial Star Destroyer.

name: Alliance Shuttle
flavorText: Lightly armored and unarmed, Rebel supply ships typically require a fighter escort to traverse contested space.

name: Rebel Trooper
flavorText: Drawn from various resistance cells, Rebel infantry are well-trained and highly motivated.

name: Temple Guardian
mainText: When you play Temple Guardian, choose: They gain 1 [attack], 1 [resource], or 1 [force] this turn.
flavorText: The temple guardian's mask and robes symbolize their devotion to preserving the Jedi's legacy.

name: AAT
rewardText: Exile up to 2 cards from your hand or discard pile.
mainText: Exile a Separatist card from the galaxy row. If you do, gain 2 [resource].
flavorText: Armored Assault Tanks wield 6 missile tubes and a heavy laser cannon to cause untold devastation.

name: MTT
mainText: Place the next Droid you purchase this turn on top of your deck.
flavorText: Multi-Troop Transports can carry a company of 112 battle droids into the thick of combat.

name: Stap
rewardText: Exile 1 card from your hand or discard pile.
mainText: If there are more enemy cards than Separatist cards in the galaxy row, gain 1 [force].

name: Tri-Fighter
mainText: Exile a Separatist card from the galaxy row. If you do, you may deal 3 damage to a capital ship your opponent has in play.

name: B2 Battle Droid
mainText: Exile a Separatist card from the galaxy row. If you do, draw 1 card.
flavorText: Better armed and armored, the super battle droid outperforms its standard counterpart in most ways.

name: Vulture Droid
rewardText: Exile 1 card from your hand or discard pile.
mainText: When you purchase this unit, add it to your hand. After this unit attacks, you must exile this card.

name: Aayla Secura
mainText: While Aayla Secura is in play and the Force is with you, each of your Trooper units gains 1 [attack].

name: Ahsoka Tano
mainText: Reveal the top card of your deck. If the Force is with you, you may swap it with a card from your discard pile.

name: Anakin Skywalker
mainText: While the Force is with you, Anakin Skywalker gains 3 [attack].
flavorText: Some believe Anakin to be the prophesied Chosen One who will bring balance to the Force.

name: AT-TE
rewardText: Purchase a card of your faction for free.
mainText: Place another unit you have in play on top of your deck.
flavorText: Although they transport troops, All Terrain Tactical Enforcers are powerful tanks in their own right.

name: Captain Rex
mainText: Captain Rex gains 1 [attack] for each unique (◆) unit in play and in the galaxy row.

name: Admiral Trench
mainText: Draw 1 card (2 cards instead if you had a capital ship in play at the start of your turn).

name: Clone Commander Cody
mainText: Place a Trooper from your discard pile on top of your deck. If the Force is with you, add it to your hand instead.

name: Mace Windu
mainText: Reveal the top card of your deck. If the Force is with you, Mace Windu gains [attack] equal to the cost of that card (to a maximum of +5 [attack]).

name: Obi-Wan Kenobi
mainText: When you reveal Obi-Wan Kenobi from the top of your deck, add him to your hand and reveal the next card instead.

name: Padmé Amidala
mainText: Draw 1 card (2 cards instead if your base is Naboo).
flavorText: The strong-willed and courageous former queen of Naboo always selflessly helps those in need.

name: ARC-170
rewardText: Exile up to 2 cards from your hand or discard pile.
mainText: Reveal the top card of your deck. If it is a Fighter or a Trooper, this unit gains 2 [attack].

name: AT-RT
rewardText: Exile 1 card from your hand or discard pile.
mainText: If you have another Trooper in play, repair 2 damage from your base.
flavorText: All Terrain Reconnaissance Transports can run up to 60 km/h.

name: Barc Trooper
rewardText: Exile 1 card from your hand or discard pile.
mainText: While you have another Trooper in play, this unit gains 2 [attack].
flavorText: Biker Advanced Recon Commandos can quickly redeploy to where they are needed most.

name: Delta-7B
mainText: Reveal the top card of your deck. If it is a Jedi, you may draw it. If it is not, you may discard it.

name: LAAT Gunship
mainText: Reveal the top card of your deck. If it is a Jedi or Trooper, you may draw it.
flavorText: Clones and Jedi alike have come to respect the Low Altitude Assault Transport gunship.

name: V-19 Torrent
mainText: Reveal the top card of your deck. You may discard it.
flavorText: The V-19 Torrent was an early-war design created to escort the less maneuverable LAAT gunship.

name: Asajj Ventress
rewardText: Purchase a card of your faction for free.
mainText: Discard each neutral unit from the galaxy row (and 1 enemy unit if the [force] is with you).

name: Arc Trooper
mainText: If you have a Jedi or another Trooper in play, deal 2 damage to your opponent's base.

name: Aurra Sing
mainText: While there is a Bounty Hunter in the galaxy row, Aurra Sing gains 2 [attack].
flavorText: A Palliduvan ex-Jedi, Aurra Sing is an infamous markswoman, preferring to take assassination contracts where she can use her sniper rifle.

name: Cad Bane
mainText: If you have at least 3 neutral cards in play, choose: Destroy a capital ship your opponent has in play, or exile 1 card from your hand or discard pile.
flavorText: With the right crew, the creatively cunning Cad Bane pulls off unthinkable tasks such as infiltrating the Jedi Temple and staging prison breaks.

name: Embo
mainText: Embo gains 1 [attack] for each other neutral card you have in play (to a maximum of +6 [attack]).
flavorText: Embo, a soft-spoken Kyuzo, is famous for fighting with his bowcaster and using his large hat as both a shield and a thrown weapon.

name: Fett's Firespray
mainText: Add a neutral unit from your discard pile to your hand. If it is a Bounty Hunter, that unit gains 2 [attack] while attacking a target in the galaxy row this turn.
flavorText: Jango Fett (and eventually Boba Fett) hunted and transported countless bounties in this iconic craft.

name: Hondo Ohnaka
mainText: When you purchase a card with a cost of 4 or more, draw 1 card.
flavorText: As the leader of the Ohnaka Gang, the notorious Weequay pirate king Hondo Ohnaka attempts to leverage every interaction he has to find profits.

name: Jango Fett
mainText: When Jango Fett defeats a target in the galaxy row, draw 1 card.
flavorText: Despite being the template for all clone troopers, Jango Fett still takes independent contracts without the Republic's consent.

name: Jar Jar Binks
mainText: When you purchase or play Jar Jar Binks, you may spend 2 [resource] to gain 1 [force] and place him in your opponent's discard pile.
flavorText: Although initially an outcast from his society, Jar Jar stumbled his way into being a Bombad General and eventually a Nabooian Senator.

name: Latts Razzi
mainText: When Latts Razzi defeats a target in the galaxy row, gain 1 [resource] for each Bounty Hunter in play and in the galaxy row.
flavorText: Often willing to team up with other bounty hunters for the biggest scores, this stylish Theelin specializes in using an unusual grappling boa during combat.

name: Zam Wesell
mainText: When you play Zam Wesell, choose: She gains 2 [attack], 2 [resource], or 2 [force] this turn.
flavorText: A slippery Clawdite, Zam Wesell uses her natural abilities to adapt on the fly during missions, sometimes even disguising herself as her target.

name: Count Dooku
mainText: If the Force is with you, swap a unit in the galaxy row with a non-starter card from your exile pile.

name: Assassin Droid
mainText: This unit can attack a neutral unit in the galaxy row using that unit's cost as its target value. If you defeat that unit, gain [resource] equal to its cost. You can commit other units to this attack.
flavorText: Without the empathy shared by most organics, some assassin droids are built as merciless hunters.

name: Gauntlet Starfighter
mainText: Exile this unit to purchase a card from the galaxy discard pile as if it were in the galaxy row and add that card to your hand.
flavorText: Although not as nimble as its smaller cousin the Fang Fighter, Mandalorians use the Kom'rk-class fighter as both a troop transport and a starfighter.

name: Hutt Fighter
mainText: Spend 2 [resource] to have this unit gain 2 [force].
flavorText: Always looking to make credits, the Hutts are not above exploiting the uncertain situations created by galaxy-spanning wars.

name: Protocol Droid
mainText: Exile this card to discard cards from the top of the galaxy deck until you discard a card of your faction. Swap that card with a neutral unit in the galaxy row.
flavorText: Coming in all shapes and sizes, each chassis is designed to perfectly suit the needs of the client.

name: Super Commando
mainText: When you purchase this unit, add him to your hand (and you may exile 1 card from your hand or discard pile if the Force is with you).
flavorText: These Mandalorians are loyal to Maul following his possession of the dark saber and his subsequent victory over Pre Vizsla in traditional single combat.

name: Underworld Contact
mainText: If the Force is with you, spend 2 fewer [resource] on the next neutral card you purchase.
flavorText: When it comes to getting ahead of your competition, sometimes it is not what you know, but who you know.

name: Weequay Pirate
mainText: If you have another neutral card in play, draw 1 card.
flavorText: Originating from the desert planet Sriluur in Hutt space, many Weequay easily find work as mercenaries, pirates, or bodyguards.

name: General Grievous
mainText: When General Grievous defeats a target in the galaxy row, exile a Droid from your hand. If you do, receive that target's reward a second time.

name: Nute Gunray
mainText: The next time a card leaves the galaxy row this turn, replace it with a non-starter card from your exile pile.

name: Wat Tambor
mainText: Discard 1 neutral card from the galaxy row. If the Force is with you, you may replace it with a Separatist card from the galaxy discard pile.

name: Droideka
mainText: If you exiled at least 1 card this turn, this unit gains 2 [attack].
flavorText: Protected by personal deflector shields, Droidekas make for formidable opponents.

name: Magnaguard
mainText: While Magnaguard is in play, each of your unique (◆) units gains 1 [attack] (2 [attack] instead if the Force is with you).

name: Aurore-class Freighter
mainText: When this card is defeated, each player may exile 1 card from their hand or discard pile.
flavorText: Often associated with Zygerrian slavers, the YV-865 Aurore-class is a general-purpose freighter seen throughout the galaxy.

name: Dreadnought-class Cruiser
mainText: While Dreadnought-class Cruiser is in play, each of your neutral units gains 1 [attack].
flavorText: Despite its age, this centuries-old craft has been used time and time again as the basis for new ship designs.

name: Space Yacht
flavorText: Often a source of pride and only available to the extravagantly wealthy, large privately-owned ships are sometimes mobilized to assist in the war effort, willingly or otherwise.

name: Outer Rim Pilot
mainText: Exile this unit to gain 1 [resource].
flavorText: Most of the best freighter pilots are to be found here. — Obi-Wan Kenobi

name: Rishi
mainText: Start the game with this base in play.

name: Ryloth
mainText: When you reveal Ryloth, exile 1 enemy card from the galaxy row and place 1 card from your discard pile on top of your deck.

name: Anaxes
mainText: When you reveal Anaxes, purchase a Republic or neutral card from the galaxy row for free and add it to your hand.

name: Christophsis
mainText: When you reveal Christophsis, deal 4 damage to it. When you play a Transport, repair 1 damage from this base.

name: Coruscant
mainText: When your turn begins, reveal the top card of your deck. You may discard that card.

name: Ilum
mainText: When you reveal Ilum, gain 4 [force].

name: Kamino
mainText: When you play a Trooper for the first time each turn, add a Trooper from your discard pile to your hand.

name: Kashyyyk
mainText: When you reveal Kashyyyk, exile up to 3 cards from your hand or discard pile.

name: Naboo
mainText: While Naboo is your base, each of your capital ships gains 2 hit points.

name: Rodia
mainText: When you play a neutral card for the first time each turn, draw 1 card.

name: Consular-Class Cruiser
mainText: Swap a card in your hand with the top card of your deck.
flavorText: Primarily used to transport Jedi and diplomats across the galaxy, the Consular-class cruiser is an oft cherished Republic vessel.

name: Acclamator-Class Ship
mainText: Place the next card you purchase this turn on top of your deck.
flavorText: Heralding the sudden appearance of the Clone Army, the Acclamator-class Assault Ships are now important Republic assets.

name: Venator-Class Destroyer
mainText: While Venator-class Destroyer is in play, each of your Fighter units gains 1 [force].
flavorText: The original class of Star Destroyer, the Venator is the first of its kind and instills fear in all who oppose it.

name: Republic Shuttle
flavorText: With many different shuttles available to the Republic, the Eta-class shuttle is a good choice regardless of the friendliness of the destination.

name: Clone Trooper
flavorText: Grown under ideal laboratory conditions, each clone trooper is trained from the start to be both a loyal and proficient soldier.

name: Jedi Knight
mainText: When you play Jedi Knight, choose: They gain 1 [attack], 1 [resource], or 1 [force] this turn.
flavorText: Lauded by some as peacekeepers, Jedi are taught to use words first before resorting to violence.

name: Xorrn
mainText: Start the game with this base in play.

name: Dac
mainText: When you reveal Dac, purchase a Separatist or neutral card from the galaxy row for free and add it to your hand.

name: Cato Neimoidia
mainText: When you reveal Cato Neimoidia, discard 1 enemy card from the galaxy row. Replace it with a different enemy card from the galaxy discard pile and gain [resource] equal to the latter card's cost.

name: Serenno
mainText: When you reveal Serenno, gain 4 [force].

name: Onderon
mainText: When you reveal Onderon, exile up to 3 cards from your hand or discard pile.

name: Mygeeto
mainText: While Mygeeto is your base, you do not return unspent resources to the supply at the end of your turn.

name: Mustafar
mainText: When you play a neutral card for the first time each turn, draw 1 card.

name: Lola Sayu
mainText: When you reveal Lola Sayu, place 1 card from your opponent's discard pile facedown under this base. When this base is destroyed, return that card to your opponent's discard pile.

name: Geonosis
mainText: Spend [resource] equal to the cost of a Droid in your discard pile to add that card to your hand.

name: Felucia
mainText: While Felucia is your base, each of your Droid units gains 1 [force].

name: Munificent-class Frigate
mainText: Exile a Separatist card from the galaxy row. If you do, repair 2 damage from your base.
flavorText: The lightly-armored Munificent-class Frigate is an important part of the Separatist fleet, capable of carrying 150,000 battle droids.

name: Separatist Dreadnought
flavorText: The right to command each mighty Providence-class dreadnought is often squabbled over by high ranking officials.

name: Droid Control Ship
mainText: Purchase a Droid from your exile pile as if it were in the galaxy row.
flavorText: By providing support to seemingly endless droid armies, the Lucrehulk-class battleship can maintain lengthy planetary blockades.

name: Separatist Shuttle
flavorText: Roughly resembling a Neimoidian soldier beetle, the large fin on the back of the Sheathipede-class transport shuttle allows it to bank quickly.

name: B1 Battle Droid
mainText: Fielded en masse, the standard B1 Battle Droid often relies on command droids or organic officers to make decisions beyond who to shoot at.

name: Dark Side Agent
mainText: When you play Dark Side Agent, choose: They gain 1 [attack], 1 [resource], or 1 [force] this turn.
flavorText: Not every force user is supervised by the Jedi when they first feel the temptation of the dark side.

name: Arquitens Command Cruiser
mainText: While Arquitens Command Cruiser is in play, each of your Trooper units gains 1 [attack].
flavorText: They tend to get mad when you hijack their ships. –The Mandalorian

name: Arvala VII
mainText: When your turn begins, if the Force marker is on the neutral space, gain 1 [resource]. If it is not, move the Force marker 1 space toward neutral.

name: Axe Woves
mainText: Place Axe Woves on top of the galaxy deck to move the Force marker to the neutral space.

name: Balutar Swoop Rider
rewardText: Exile 1 card from your hand or discard pile.
mainText: When you purchase a card, move the [force] marker 1 space toward neutral.

name: Bo-Katan
mainText: If the Force marker is on the neutral space, add a Mandalorian card in your discard pile to your hand.

name: Captured Gozanti Cruiser
mainText: If the Force marker is on the neutral space, draw 1 card.
flavorText: “We are taking the ship for the battles ahead.” — Bo-Katan

name: Child of the Watch
mainText: When you play Child of the Watch, choose: They gain 1 [attack], 1 [resource], or 1 [force] this turn.
flavorText: Those who follow the Way of the Mandalore are viewed by some as religious zealots.

name: Clan Kryze Commando
rewardText: Exile 1 card from your hand or discard pile.
mainText: If the Force marker is on the neutral space, deal 2 damage to your opponent's base.

name: Concordia
mainText: When you reveal Concordia, exile up to 3 cards from your hand or discard pile.

name: Din's Starfighter
mainText: If the Force marker is on the neutral space, destroy a capital ship your opponent has in play.

name: Foundling
mainText: Exile this unit to add the next Bounty Hunter or Trooper you purchase this turn to your hand.
flavorText: By creed, foundlings can join the Mandalorians when they come of age.

name: Gauntlet Dropship
rewardText: Exile 2 cards from your hand or discard pile.
mainText: Reveal the top 5 cards of your deck. Add a revealed Trooper to your hand.
flavorText: First team, prepare to drop. – Bo-Katan

name: Glavis Ringworld
mainText: While Glavis Ringworld is your base, spend 1 fewer [resource] on the first Mandalorian card you purchase each turn.

name: Grogu
mainText: Draw 1 card (2 cards instead if you have The Mandalorian in play).
flavorText: Wherever I go, he goes. —The Mandalorian

name: Kalevala
mainText: When you play a Trooper, repair 1 damage from this base.

name: Koska Reeves
mainText: Koska Reeves can attack a neutral unit in the galaxy row using that unit's cost as its target value. If you defeat that unit, gain [resource] equal to its cost.

name: Mandalore
mainText: When you reveal Mandalore, purchase a Mandalorian or neutral card from the galaxy row for free and add it to your hand.

name: Mandalorian Hijacker
mainText: This unit can attack a capital ship in the galaxy row. If you destroy it, exile this unit to purchase that ship for free and add it to your hand.

name: Mandalorian Hunter
mainText: If the Force is with you, move the Force marker to the neutral space. This unit gains 1 [attack] for each space the Force marker moved this way.

name: Mandalorian Shuttle
flavorText: The Mandalorian Kom'rk-class transport sports a rotating-wing design that enables vertical take-off and landing.

name: Mandalorian Soldier
mainText: Mandalorian shock troops descend upon their enemies wearing jetpacks and beskar armor.

name: Paz Vizsla
mainText: Spend up to 3 [resource]. Paz Vizsla gains 1 [attack] for each [resource] spent this way.
flavorText: Get out of here! We'll hold 'em off!

name: Protectorate Fighter
mainText: When you purchase this unit, add it to your hand (and draw 1 card if the Force marker is on the neutral space).

name: Razor Crest
rewardText: Purchase a card of your faction for free.
mainText: Add the next Bounty Hunter or Trooper you purchase this turn to your hand.

name: Survivor Langskib
mainText: Choose: Move the Force marker to the neutral space, or gain 3 [resource].
flavorText: The langskib is used by Mandalorian remnants to travel the devastated surface of Mandalore.

name: Tatooine
mainText: When you play a neutral card for the first time each turn, draw 1 card.

name: The Armorer
mainText: Repair 3 damage from your base (5 damage instead if the Force marker is on the neutral space).

name: The Mandalorian
mainText: When The Mandalorian defeats a target in the galaxy row, choose a card in your discard pile. Place that card on top of your deck or exile it.

name: Trask
mainText: When you reveal Trask, choose a capital ship in the galaxy row. You can use your units to attack that ship this turn. If you destroy it, purchase it for free and add it to your hand.

name: Tython
mainText: When you reveal Tython, move the Force marker to the neutral space.

name: Concord Dawn
mainText: Start the game with this base in play.

name: Nevarro
mainText: When you defeat a non-Permanent target in the galaxy row, draw 1 card.
